ft.f: Abbreviation of featuring; used to introduce guest performer(s) on a musical recording.

fta.f: (aviation) Abbreviation of flight test article (such as a test aircraft, a prototype).
(broadcasting, telecommunications) Abbreviation of free to air.

ftfy.f: (education) Initialism of first-time first-year (often referring to offerings for entering freshmen).

ftk.f: (slang, board games, collectible card games) Initialism of first-turn kill.

s.g: (slang, gaming, transitive) To defeat (an opponent) on the first turn of a turn-based game.
s.x: He must have made some kind of deal with fate if he managed to FTK her!

fto.f: (US, law enforcement) Initialism of field training officer.

s.g: An instance of sending files via FTP (the File Transfer Protocol).
s.x: Each batch is an FTP. The log tracking them is on the dashboard.

ftp.f: (economics, business) Initialism of free trade port, a port that is a free trade zone.

s.g: (computing, transitive) To transfer using File Transfer Protocol.
s.x: We FTP the whole dataset to the customer after we've scanned it to ensure that no restricted data is left inside it.

ftps.f: third-person singular simple present indicative of FTP

fttb.f: (telecommunications) Initialism of fiber to the building.

fttc.f: (telecommunications) Initialism of fibre to the cabinet.

ftth.f: (telecommunications) Initialism of fiber to the home.

fttn.f: (telecommunications) Initialism of fibre to the node.

fttp.f: (telecommunications) Initialism of fibre to the premises.

fttx.f: (telecommunications) Initialism of fiber to the x, various configurations for the deployment of optical fiber.

ftw.f: (slang, vulgar) Initialism of fuck the world: an antisocial slogan.

ftx.f: (US military) Abbreviation of field training exercise.
